keyEvents: Bebeto gave Brazil an early lead.
Rivaldo scored twice to put Brazil in control.
Nielsen pulled one back late but Denmark could not find an equalizer.

impactPlayers.name: Rivaldo
impactPlayers.summary: Scored twice and finally looked like the player Brazil needed.

impactPlayers.name: Bebeto
impactPlayers.summary: Scored inside three minutes and set Brazil's attacking tone.

impactPlayers.name: Thomas Jørgensen
impactPlayers.summary: Scored before halftime and kept Denmark competitive.

title: Knockout Chapter
world: Marseille hosts a quarterfinal between two nations that expect to compete for the highest honors.
tournament: The Netherlands survived Yugoslavia in the last sixteen. Argentina arrive after eliminating England in one of the tournament's most dramatic ties.
intro: The Netherlands bring attacking talent and the frustration of never quite fulfilling their potential on the biggest stage. Argentina bring individual brilliance and the confidence of having survived a penalty shootout. Both teams believe they belong in the semifinals.

postMatch.goal: Patrick Kluivert 12′; Roberto Ayala 36′; Dennis Bergkamp 89′
keyEvents: Kluivert gave the Netherlands an early lead.
Ayala equalized before halftime.
Bergkamp scored a late winner to send the Netherlands through.

impactPlayers.name: Dennis Bergkamp
impactPlayers.summary: Scored one of the tournament's most memorable goals in the closing stages.

impactPlayers.name: Patrick Kluivert
impactPlayers.summary: Gave the Netherlands an early advantage.

impactPlayers.name: Roberto Ayala
impactPlayers.summary: Kept Argentina in the match with a first-half header.

title: Knockout Chapter
world: Lyon hosts a quarterfinal that pits European experience against the rising force of Croatian football.
tournament: Germany controlled their group and eliminated Mexico professionally. Croatia arrive with the confidence of having beaten Romania with a moment of individual brilliance.
intro: Germany bring the expectation that comes with being one of Europe's most successful nations. Croatia bring technical quality and the fearlessness of a team that believes it belongs among the world's best. The gap in history may be wide; the gap in current form may be less so.

postMatch.goal: Robert Jarni 45′; Goran Vlaović 46′; Zvonimir Boban 85′
keyEvents: Croatia scored three times in a stunning upset.
Jarni opened the scoring on the stroke of halftime.
Vlaović and Boban sealed one of the tournament's biggest surprises.

impactPlayers.name: Goran Vlaović
impactPlayers.summary: Scored immediately after halftime and killed German hopes.

impactPlayers.name: Robert Jarni
impactPlayers.summary: Scored a spectacular goal that set the tone.

impactPlayers.name: Zvonimir Boban
impactPlayers.summary: Sealed the result and completed Croatia's statement.

title: Knockout Chapter
world: The semifinals begin as four teams remain and every player is now one match from the final.
tournament: Brazil and the Netherlands have both survived dramatic knockout ties. Now one advances to the final while the other faces the pain of falling one step short.
intro: Brazil bring the individual quality that makes them favorites to retain their title. The Netherlands bring attacking talent and the belief that this may finally be their moment. Semifinals can be cautious until one moment alters the emotional balance.

postMatch.goal: Ronaldo 46′; Patrick Kluivert 87′
keyEvents: Ronaldo gave Brazil the lead shortly after halftime.
Kluivert equalized late in regulation.
Brazil won the penalty shootout 4–2.

impactPlayers.name: Ronaldo
impactPlayers.summary: Scored after halftime and looked like the player Brazil needed.

impactPlayers.name: Patrick Kluivert
impactPlayers.summary: Scored a crucial late goal to force extra time.

impactPlayers.name: Cláudio Taffarel
impactPlayers.summary: Saved penalties and sent Brazil to the final.

title: Knockout Chapter
world: The host nation's semifinal arrives as an entire country gathers to see whether the dream can reach the final.
tournament: France survived Italy on penalties in the quarterfinals. Croatia arrive after stunning Germany and announcing themselves as one of the tournament's most dangerous teams.
intro: France carry the weight of a nation's expectations into the biggest match of their campaign so far. Croatia bring technical quality and the confidence of having eliminated Germany. The host nation knows that defeat here would feel like the end of a dream.

postMatch.goal: Davor Šuker 46′; Lilian Thuram 47′, 69′
keyEvents: Šuker gave Croatia a second-half lead.
Thuram scored twice to send the host nation to the final.
France's dream remained alive.

impactPlayers.name: Lilian Thuram
impactPlayers.summary: Scored both French goals in the most important match of his career.

impactPlayers.name: Davor Šuker
impactPlayers.summary: Gave Croatia a lead that briefly silenced the Stade de France.

impactPlayers.name: Fabien Barthez
impactPlayers.summary: Maintained concentration when Croatia threatened to extend their lead.

title: Knockout Chapter
world: One match remains before the final, but this game has its own meaning for two teams closing memorable campaigns.
tournament: The Netherlands and Croatia meet for third place after falling one step short of the final.
intro: The emotional challenge is unusual: both teams must recover quickly from semifinal disappointment and find a reason to finish strongly. These matches can become open because the fear of elimination has already passed.

postMatch.goal: Robert Prosinečki 14′; Patrick Kluivert 16′; Zvonimir Boban 36′; Davor Šuker 77′
keyEvents: Prosinečki opened the scoring before Kluivert equalized.
Boban restored Croatia's lead before halftime.
Šuker sealed Croatia's third-place finish in the second half.

impactPlayers.name: Robert Prosinečki
impactPlayers.summary: Scored early and set Croatia's attacking tone.

impactPlayers.name: Patrick Kluivert
impactPlayers.summary: Pulled the Netherlands level before Croatia restored their lead.

impactPlayers.name: Davor Šuker
impactPlayers.summary: Sealed Croatia's third-place finish.

title: Knockout Chapter
world: After one month, the tournament reaches its final match at the Stade de France.
tournament: Brazil and the host nation are the last two teams standing. Everything before this has led to one final afternoon.
intro: Both nations understand this stage and the weight attached to it. Brazil arrive as defending champions seeking to retain their title on foreign soil. France carry the dreams of a host nation that has progressed steadily toward this moment. There is no next match.

postMatch.goal: Zinédine Zidane 27′, 45+2′; Emmanuel Petit 90+3′
keyEvents: Zidane scored twice from headers before halftime.
Petit added a third in stoppage time.
The host nation won the World Cup on home soil.

impactPlayers.name: Zinédine Zidane
impactPlayers.summary: Scored both first-half goals and controlled the match's emotional center.

impactPlayers.name: Emmanuel Petit
impactPlayers.summary: Sealed the victory in the final moments.

impactPlayers.name: Fabien Barthez
impactPlayers.summary: Commanded his area and gave France defensive security throughout.
